memory_update.text: PLPC should be promoted to the underfollowed grid-hardware watchlist as a niche public manufacturer of products used in energy-network construction and maintenance; verify energy product mix, backlog, and utility/customer exposure before upgrading beyond inference.

HUBB is the reference benchmark for utility T&D hardware and controls because Utility Solutions is majority of revenue and directly includes transmission, distribution, substation, components, meters, AMI, and protection/control products.

POWL belongs in the direct/second-order underfollowed lane for substations, switchgear, power distribution, controls, and utility electrical infrastructure, but its oil, gas, LNG, and industrial exposure must be separated from grid demand.

MYRG is a smaller Quanta-style demand-confirmation name for T&D construction and backlog signals; use it to validate hardware pull-through and labor/material bottlenecks rather than treating it as a hardware supplier.

Need a follow-up search for other obscure US-listed hardware suppliers around insulators, connectors, bushings, conductor accessories, pole hardware, substation protection, grid testing/inspection, and specialty distributors; current pass includes only four candidates.

summary: Layer 1B expansion for the grid transmission and distribution node identifies one obvious large-cap reference supplier, two mid/small-cap direct infrastructure names, and one highly focused small-cap hardware candidate. The cleanest underfollowed exposure appears to be Preformed Line Products because it sells physical products used in overhead and underground energy networks rather than general construction services. Powell Industries and MYR Group are less pure to tower/pole hardware but remain direct beneficiaries through substation, electrical distribution, transmission construction, and utility project backlog. Hubbell is included as the reference leader because its Utility Solutions segment directly addresses transmission, distribution, substation, grid protection, and controls, but its size and diversification make it less suitable for the underfollowed lane.
